question: What is the primary mechanism by which a medication abortion terminates a pregnancy?

options.A: Freezing of the gestational sac using cryotherapy
options.B: Electrical stimulation of the myometrium to cause spasms
options.C: Surgical suction of the uterine cavity via a cannula
options.D: Pharmaceutical agents inducing a process similar to a miscarriage

explanation: Medication abortion uses specific drugs to mimic a natural miscarriage rather than utilizing surgical instruments. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h1)

question: Why is understanding the gestational age limit crucial for medication abortion?

options.A: Surgical backup is physically impossible once the second trimester begins
options.B: Patients develop permanent immunity to the medications after a certain week
options.C: Drugs used in the protocol automatically become illegal after the first trimester
options.D: The method loses effectiveness and carries higher complication risks past specific thresholds

explanation: Pharmaceutical termination protocols are strictly time-sensitive; exceeding approved gestational limits significantly increases failure rates and hemorrhage risks. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h1)

question: What is the primary pharmacological action of mifepristone?
explanation: Mifepristone blocks progesterone receptors, leading to the breakdown of the decidua and cervical softening. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h2)

question: What role does misoprostol play when administered after mifepristone?

options.A: Stimulates uterine contractions to expel the pregnancy tissue
options.B: Neutralizes remaining hormones in the systemic circulation
options.C: Prevents nausea and vomiting caused by the first drug
options.D: Anesthetizes the myometrium to block procedural pain

explanation: Misoprostol acts as a prostaglandin analog that triggers strong myometrial contractions to empty the uterus. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h2)

question: Which condition is an absolute contraindication for a medication abortion regimen?

options.B: A history of mild seasonal allergies

explanation: Medication abortion only evacuates the intrauterine cavity and will fail to resolve an ectopic pregnancy, risking fatal rupture. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h3)

question: A client presents requesting a medication abortion, and transvaginal ultrasound reveals an intrauterine pregnancy alongside a copper IUD. What must happen first?

options.A: Antibiotics must be administered to cover potential IUD-related infections
options.B: The medical regimen can proceed immediately with the IUD left in situ
options.C: The patient must be switched to a purely surgical pathway without exception
options.D: The intrauterine device must be safely removed prior to starting the medication

explanation: An existing IUD increases the risk of infection and hemorrhage, so it must be removed before initiating medical termination. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h3)

question: Why is Rh blood typing clinically necessary before administering a medication abortion?

options.A: To screen for underlying hereditary coagulation disorders
options.B: To confirm that the pregnancy is located inside the uterus
options.C: To calculate the exact gestational age down to the day
options.D: To determine if an Rh-negative patient requires anti-D immunoglobulin

explanation: Rh testing identifies patients at risk of sensitization, allowing nurses to administer anti-D immune globulin promptly. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h4)

question: What is an essential component of pre-procedure counseling for a medical abortion?

options.A: Requiring mandatory psychiatric clearance before any medications are dispensed
options.B: Instructing the client to avoid all oral hydration during the process
options.C: Guarantees that the procedure will be entirely painless from start to finish
options.D: Preparing the patient for the level of cramping and bleeding they will experience

explanation: Setting clear expectations about heavy bleeding and cramping helps reduce anxiety and prevents panic when symptoms peak. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h4)

question: What is the typical time interval recommended between taking mifepristone and administering misoprostol?
explanation: A latency period of 24 to 48 hours allows mifepristone to adequately prime the uterus before misoprostol is taken. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h5)

question: How does incorrect sequencing or timing of the two abortion medications affect the outcome?

options.A: It turns the medical abortion into a permanent surgical sterilization
options.B: It accelerates the process so fast that no cramping occurs
options.C: It can significantly reduce the overall efficacy of the termination process
options.D: It neutralizes all side effects but leaves the pregnancy completely unaffected

explanation: The protocol relies on the priming action of the first drug to make the uterine contractions of the second drug effective. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h5)

question: Which systemic symptom is commonly caused by misoprostol during a medication abortion?

options.D: Permanent loss of deep tendon reflexes

explanation: Prostaglandins frequently induce temporary side effects such as chills, mild fever, and nausea that resolve on their own. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h6)

question: How should a nurse interpret reports of heavy bleeding and strong cramping shortly after taking misoprostol?

options.A: As expected signs that the treatment is successfully inducing tissue expulsion
options.B: As proof that the mifepristone dose failed to absorb properly
options.C: As a sign of severe allergic hypersensitivity to the prostaglandin
options.D: As an immediate indication of uterine rupture requiring emergency surgery

explanation: Heavy bleeding and strong cramping are the normal physiological response to misoprostol emptying the uterus. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h6)

question: What clinical threshold defines excessive post-abortion hemorrhage requiring urgent evaluation?

options.A: A total blood loss equivalent to a heavy normal menstrual cycle
options.B: Passing three small blood clots the size of a coin in one day
options.C: Soaking through two large sanitary pads per hour for two consecutive hours
options.D: Bleeding that continues intermittently for up to fourteen days

explanation: This specific heavy-bleeding benchmark signals potential hemorrhage that exceeds normal parameters and requires clinical intervention. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h7)

question: Which combination of symptoms is most characteristic of post-abortion infection?

options.A: Sudden hair loss, severe headache, and elevated blood pressure
options.B: Temporary nausea and mild diarrhea on the first day of treatment
options.C: Foul-smelling vaginal discharge, fever, and persistent lower abdominal pain
options.D: Transient chills within two hours of taking misoprostol

explanation: Fever, localized pain, and malodorous discharge are classic indicators of an intrauterine infection or endometritis. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h7)

question: When can a patient typically start a new method of contraception following a medication abortion?

options.A: Only after surgical confirmation of complete endometrial healing
options.B: After a mandatory six-month recovery period with barrier methods
options.C: Immediately on the day of treatment or at the follow-up visit
options.D: Only after waiting for three complete normal menstrual cycles

explanation: Ovulation can resume very quickly, so initiating contraception immediately prevents unintended rapid repeat pregnancies. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h8)

question: Why is timely post-abortion follow-up essential for clinical quality care?

options.A: To remove the systemic hormones of the medication from the liver
options.B: To confirm complete termination and ensure no ongoing pregnancy or retained tissue exists
options.C: To legally clear the patient to return to work or school activities
options.D: To administer the primary dose of mifepristone under direct observation

explanation: A follow-up check verifies that the medical abortion was fully successful and catches any incomplete evacuations early. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T011#GNS226_U5_T011_h8)
